title: pallenis spinosa
intro: Pallenis spinosa, commonly known as the "thistle of the sea" or "sea holly", is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to aid in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pallenis spinosa include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for stress and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Pallenis spinosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
